articles.title: 240 UK taxpayers made more than $1.3 million each from crypto holdings in fiscal 2025
articles.snippet: For the first time, the U.K.'s tax office broke out crypto capital gains figures, showing 17,600 people reported $1.87 billion in profits during the 2024-2025 tax year.

articles.title: AI bug reports trigger emergency warning for Bitcoin Lightning node operators
articles.snippet: Developers are holding details for two weeks while fixes reach operators, in the second Lightning security emergency this month traced to AI work on Bitcoin code.

articles.title: Unstoppable Domains drops $2 million plan to bring .crypto and .bitcoin to standard internet
articles.snippet: The abandoned bids would have cost over $2 million in base fees alone, leading the firm to prioritize financial viability over broader internet adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoin researchers propose quantum fix that would not crowd out transactions
articles.snippet: The SHRINCS proposal would let bitcoin transactions use larger, quantum-resistant approvals while preserving more network capacity than existing post-quantum signature designs.

articles.title: Binance co-founders CZ and Yi He adopted Simpsons cartoon aliases ‘Homer’ and ‘Marge’ in company meetings
articles.snippet: Yi, who is now the co-CEO of Binance alongside its other chief Richard Teng, still uses the name Marge in meetings and chats.
